tool_schemas.name: create_page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion page under the specified parent (page, database, or workspace), optionally setting title, properties, icon/cover, and initial child blocks, and returns the created Notion page object as mirrored by this server. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parent.type is not one of page_id|database_id|workspace, if parent.notion_id is missing when required, or if the request includes fields outside the schema; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is unknown/disabled or the Notion token is not valid, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks access to the parent, NOT_FOUND if the parent does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when Notion or server quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when the parent is in a state that refuses writes (e.g., archived/deleted) or when the supplied properties cannot be applied to the target database schema.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

parent.description: Notion parent reference for the new page (page, database, or workspace).

notion_id.description: Notion page/database ID for the parent (required unless type is workspace).

title.description: Page title to set (mapped to the database title property when parent is a database).

properties.description: Notion page properties payload (Notion API 'properties' object).

icon.description: Notion icon object for the page.

cover.description: Notion cover object for the page.

children.description: Initial content blocks to append as children on creation (Notion API block objects).

tool_schemas.name: get_page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a Notion page by ID and returns the current page object from Notion and/or the local mirror (including its archived state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed connection_id or missing/empty notion_page_id, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot access the page, and NOT_FOUND if the page ID does not exist or is not visible to the integration. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

tool_schemas.name: update_page
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Notion page’s properties and/or icon/cover, and can archive or unarchive the page via the archived flag, returning the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the update payload is invalid for Notion (e.g., malformed properties object) or if unknown fields are provided, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks permission to edit the page, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT if the page is deleted or otherwise in a state that refuses the requested transition (e.g., attempting to modify content on a page that cannot be edited), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

properties.description: Notion page properties payload to update (Notion API 'properties' object).

archived.description: Whether the page is archived (true to archive, false to unarchive).

icon.description: Notion icon object to set for the page.

cover.description: Notion cover object to set for the page.

tool_schemas.name: archive_page
tool_schemas.description: Archives the specified Notion page (sets archived=true) and returns the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot edit the page, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT if the page is already archived or is in a deleted state that cannot be archived, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

tool_schemas.name: restore_page
tool_schemas.description: Restores (unarchives) the specified Notion page (sets archived=false) and returns the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot edit the page, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT if the page is not archived or is deleted and cannot be restored via unarchive, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

tool_schemas.name: get_page_property
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a page property item for the given page and property ID and returns the Notion property item object; for paginated property types, results are returned as a list with has_more and next_cursor, controlled by start_cursor and page_size (1–100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_size is out of range or required IDs are missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot access the page/property, and NOT_FOUND if the page or property ID does not exist or is not visible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

notion_page_id.description: Notion page ID that owns the property.

notion_property_id.description: Notion property ID to retrieve as a property item.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for property items that return lists.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page when the property is paginated.

tool_schemas.name: add_todo
tool_schemas.description: Creates a todo as a new page in the target todos database (explicit todos_database_id or the connection’s configured todos database), deriving Notion properties from title/description/due_date/completed/priority/tags/assignees/url and merging any provided raw properties override, optionally appending content_blocks, and returns the created page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is missing/empty, due_date is not ISO-8601 date-time, content_blocks/properties are not valid Notion payloads, or the resolved todos database is not configured; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot write to the database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT when the database is archived/deleted or when derived/override fields cannot be mapped onto the database schema (e.g., missing required title property), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

todos_database_id.description: Notion database ID to create the todo in (defaults to the connection's configured todos database when omitted).

description.description: Optional rich description text for the todo.

completed.description: Whether the todo is marked completed.

priority.description: Priority label/value to set (mapped to a select/status property in the target database if present).

tags.description: Tag values to set (mapped to a multi_select property in the target database if present).

assignees.description: Notion user IDs to assign (mapped to a people property in the target database if present).

url.description: Optional external URL associated with the todo.

properties.description: Raw Notion properties object to merge/override any derived todo fields.

content_blocks.description: Optional content blocks to append to the created todo page.

tool_schemas.name: search_todos
tool_schemas.description: Queries the target todos database (explicit todos_database_id or the connection’s configured todos database) using an optional free-text query plus optional Notion filter/sorts, and returns a paged list of matching todo pages with has_more and next_cursor; pagination is controlled by start_cursor and page_size (1–100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_size is out of range, filter/sorts are not valid Notion query objects, or no todos database can be resolved; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot read the database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

todos_database_id.description: Notion database ID to search (defaults to the connection's configured todos database when omitted).

query.description: Free-text search query to apply (typically against the title property).

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next results page.

page_size.description: Number of todos to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: create_database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion database under the specified parent page with the provided title and schema, and returns the created database object as mirrored by this server. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title/schema are missing or not valid Notion database property definitions, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot create databases under the parent page, and NOT_FOUND if the parent page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT if the parent page is archived/deleted or otherwise refuses writes, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to use for the request.

parent_page_notion_id.description: Notion page ID where the new database will be created.

schema.description: Database properties/schema definition to create in Notion.

tool_schemas.name: query_database
tool_schemas.description: Queries the specified Notion database using optional filter and sorts and returns a paged list of result pages with has_more and next_cursor (when pagination parameters are provided/supported for the query). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the database ID is missing/invalid or if filter/sorts are not valid Notion query objects, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot read the database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and CONFLICT if the database is in an archived/deleted state that refuses querying.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to use for the request.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

start_cursor.description: Cursor for pagination to continue from a previous query response.

tool_schemas.name: verify_connection
tool_schemas.description: Verifies that the specified Notion connection can authenticate with the Notion API and returns the current verification result (including whether the token is valid and usable for API calls). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id does not match the required ULID format, NOT_FOUND if the connection_id is not present in the integration server, and UNAUTHORIZED if the stored credentials are missing, revoked, or otherwise rejected by Notion.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to verify.

tool_schemas.name: get_database_info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the configured Notion database metadata for the given connection (the database object and its schema as mirrored by the integration server and/or retrieved from Notion). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the connection does not exist or has no configured database, and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not permitted to read the database in Notion.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) whose configured database will be fetched.

tool_schemas.name: add_content_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided block payloads as children of parent_notion_block_id and returns the created child blocks in the order added; if after_notion_block_id is provided, inserts immediately after that existing child under the same parent. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if blocks is empty, if required fields are missing, or if after_notion_block_id is not a child of the specified parent, NOT_FOUND if the connection or parent block (or the referenced after block) cannot be found, and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection lacks permission to edit the parent block in Notion.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to use for the request.

parent_notion_block_id.description: Notion block ID to append children to.

blocks.description: List of Notion block objects to add as children.

items.description: A Notion block payload (type + content) to append.

after_notion_block_id.description: If provided, inserts the new blocks after this Notion child block ID under the same parent.

tool_schemas.name: get_block_content
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the Notion block for notion_block_id (including its type-specific content) using the specified connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the connection or block does not exist (or is not accessible/mirrored for this connection), and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection cannot read that block in Notion.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to use for the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_block_children
tool_schemas.description: Lists and returns the child blocks of notion_block_id, paged by page_size (default server behavior) and start_cursor; the response includes the current page of children plus pagination fields (next_cursor and has_more) to continue listing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_size is outside 1–100 or the cursor is invalid for this listing, NOT_FOUND if the connection or parent block does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection lacks permission to read the parent block’s children in Notion.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to use for the request.

notion_block_id.description: Notion block ID whose children should be listed.

page_size.description: Maximum number of child blocks to return per page.

start_cursor.description: Cursor for pagination to continue from a previous children list response.

tool_schemas.name: update_block_content
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified block by applying the provided type-specific content changes and/or setting archived, and returns the updated block as stored in Notion and mirrored locally. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the content payload does not match the block type or contains unsupported fields, NOT_FOUND if the connection or block does not exist, CONFLICT if the update is not allowed for the block’s current state (for example, attempting to modify a block that is already archived/deleted), and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection cannot edit the block in Notion.

connection_id.description: Notion connection ULID (local mirror) to use for the request.

archived.description: Whether to archive the block in Notion.

content.description: Block-type-specific content payload used to update the block.

tool_schemas.name: delete_block
tool_schemas.description: Archives the specified Notion block (Notion’s delete behavior) and marks it deleted in the local mirror, returning the resulting block state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id or notion_block_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the connection or block cannot be found, CONFLICT if the block is already archived/deleted or cannot transition to deleted from its current state, and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection lacks permission to delete/archive the block in Notion.

connection_id.description: ULID of the Notion connection to use (notion_connections.id).

notion_block_id.description: Notion block ID to delete/archive in Notion and mark deleted in the local mirror.

tool_schemas.name: list_connections
tool_schemas.description: Lists Notion connections visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status, returning paginated connection metadata (never returns encrypted_access_token). Refuses invalid pagination parameters and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated to this integration server.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: create_connection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion connection by storing the Notion API base URL/version and a Notion integration access token, then optionally verifying it via a live Notion API call. Returns the created connection record (excluding encrypted_access_token). Refuses malformed tokens/URLs, and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated to this integration server.

notion_api_base_url.description: Base URL for Notion API (e.g., https://api.notion.com).

notion_api_version.description: Notion-Version header value to use for calls (YYYY-MM-DD).

access_token.description: Notion integration secret/token to encrypt and store for this connection.

verify_on_create.description: If true, immediately verifies the token with a live Notion API call and populates workspace/bot user fields when available.

tool_schemas.name: set_connection_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a notion connection lifecycle status (active↔disabled, active/disabled→revoked) and returns the updated connection. Refuses illegal transitions (e.g., revoked→active), and refuses to transition a connection that does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

status.description: Target lifecycle status for the connection.

reason.description: Optional audit note for why the status was changed.

tool_schemas.name: archive_block
tool_schemas.description: Archives (soft-deletes) a Notion block by setting archived=true in Notion and transitions the local mirror notion_blocks.status from 'active' to 'archived', returning the updated block mirror. Idempotent if already archived. Refuses to archive blocks already in 'deleted' state and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not active.

connection_id.description: Integration connection ULID to use for the Notion API call.

metadata.name: Notion API Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a local mirror of Notion objects (pages, databases, blocks, and page properties) plus operational metadata for an integration server (connections, sync state, request logs). Main workflows: verify/authenticate a Notion connection, create/query databases and pages (including todos
